props.name: checked
props.description:
Whether the switch is checked (controlled). Accepts `trueValue`, `falseValue`, or a boolean.
Leave it `undefined` for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: checkedIcon
props.description: Icon shown on the thumb when the switch is checked. No icon is rendered when omitted.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Whether the switch is initially checked (uncontrolled). Form reset returns to this state.

props.name: description
props.description: Description shown with the label and linked to the control as its accessible description.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the control is disabled: it cannot be interacted with and sets `aria-disabled`.
When omitted, the control inherits `disabled` from the surrounding `Field`; an explicit
`false` overrides the `Field`.

props.name: falseValue
props.description:
Value that `onCheckedChange` receives when the switch becomes unchecked, and that `checked`
accepts for the unchecked state.

props.name: form
props.description:
The id of a `<form>` the hidden input belongs to, instead of the closest
ancestor form.

props.name: id
props.description:
The ID of the control's main focusable element, which a surrounding `Field` label points to
with `for`. A unique ID is generated when omitted. The control's related parts (hidden
input, label, description) derive their IDs from it, so keep it unique on the page.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Receives the hidden `<input type="checkbox">` that submits the switch with a form.

props.name: label
props.description:
Label for the switch. It is a `<label>` for the control and its accessible name unless the
surrounding `Field` provides one.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Whether the switch is in a loading state. A loading switch is disabled and shows `loadingIcon`
on the thumb in place of the checked or unchecked icon.

props.name: loadingIcon
props.description: Icon shown on the thumb while `loading` is set.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the control, used for native form submission. When omitted, the control uses
the name of its form binding or a string `name` set on the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description:
Called when the user toggles the switch, with `trueValue` (checked) or `falseValue`
(unchecked), which are `true` and `false` by default. It does not fire for programmatic
changes to `checked`, or while the switch is `disabled`, `readOnly`, or `loading`.

props.name: onPointerDown
props.description:
Pointer down handler for the switch track (the `role="switch"` button). It runs before the
switch's own handling; call `event.preventDefault()` to skip that.

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Whether the control is read-only: the value is visible and focusable but cannot be changed,
and `aria-readonly` is set. When omitted, the control inherits `readOnly` from the
surrounding `Field`.

props.name: required
props.description:
Whether the control is required, which sets `aria-required` (and the native `required`
attribute where the control renders a native input). When omitted, the control inherits
`required` from the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: trueValue
props.description:
Value that `onCheckedChange` receives when the switch becomes checked, and that `checked`
accepts for the checked state. Use it to map the state to a domain value.
examples:
import { Switch } from 'moraine'

<Switch
  label="Theme"
  trueValue="dark"
  falseValue="light"
  defaultChecked
  onCheckedChange={(mode) => console.log(mode)}
/>

props.name: uncheckedIcon
props.description: Icon shown on the thumb when the switch is unchecked. No icon is rendered when omitted.

props.name: value
props.description:
Native value of the hidden checkbox, submitted under `name` when the switch is checked. Nothing
is submitted while it is unchecked. This is separate from `trueValue`, which is what callbacks receive.
